product_contract.beta: T20-T26 close the source-backed worldgen, all ordinary non-post-1.0 chemistry, all non-post-1.0 petrochemical source rows plus industrial downstream use, selected industrial multiblocks, reproducible scale evidence and the public-release path required for an industrial-mainline Beta.
product_contract.v1: CrucibleCraft v1.0 provides a complete and stably publishable GT6-style industrial mainline; it does not claim a complete GT6 or GT6U port.

completion_signal.closure: Every industrial-mainline item classified v1_required has an executable fresh-world and upgrade path, and v1_required is zero at RC.
completion_signal.fidelity: Every shipped fact is SOURCE_BACKED, SOURCE_DERIVED or an explicit DESIGN_POLICY; no undeclared PLACEHOLDER or UNVERIFIED fact remains on the v1 path.
completion_signal.load: Declared publication, reload, index, memory, network and operation-count budgets pass with evidence of the declared kind.

non_claims: GT6 720841 source rows are fully ported
all GT6 machine, prefix, cover or multiblock denominator identities are implemented
GT6U or third-party content is included

execution_policy.t28_plus_policy: Generate consecutive single-family, single-physics or single-player-loop cards only after T27 classifies the complete portfolio.

t20_start_evidence.non_claim: The 129 CrucibleCraft catalog identities are not 129 canonical GT6 large veins; DESIGN_POLICY rows are excluded from GT6 parity.

opening_runtime_snapshot.scope: Runtime/data baseline captured before this documentation-only planning change; recipe counts remain current because the planning change adds no recipe or runtime content.

t13_denominators.interpretation: These are source classification universes, not implementation-completion denominators or v1 requirements.

historical_or_non_current_counters.meaning: Historical pre-T19 authored snapshot recorded in the overall-plan narrative.
T20 opening snapshot from 2026-08-07; superseded by the T22/T23 datapack increments that yield 3243.

counter_resolution.rule: A number must carry its counter name, artifact and snapshot date. Bare authored or datapack counts are forbidden.

measurement_vocabulary.source_fact: One normalized fixed-revision GT6 fact before CrucibleCraft rule authoring.
measurement_vocabulary.datapack_file: One concrete recipe resource counted by the current full-verification snapshot.
measurement_vocabulary.logical_row: One complete runtime recipe relation after rule expansion.
measurement_vocabulary.eager_row: One logical row materialized during publication.
measurement_vocabulary.lazy_row: One logical row retained as an on-demand relation.
measurement_vocabulary.prohibition: These counters are never added, divided or presented as a completion percentage unless numerator and denominator share the same identity and semantics.

vocabulary.v1_required: Must close before the v1.0 RC can be numbered.
vocabulary.post_1_0: Explicitly deferred beyond v1.0 with an owner, reason, replacement condition and recheck point.
vocabulary.out_of_scope: Excluded from the CrucibleCraft v1 product contract.
vocabulary.unclassified: No reviewed v1 disposition exists; allowed during planning but must be zero after T27.
